title: OpenADS
description: Segment acute stroke core and hypoperfusion on DWI/PWI, score JHU-ICBM arterial/ASPECTS territories with TreeSHAP, and explore StrokeView cohort neighbors.

analyze.title: Run acute stroke analysis
analyze.description: Analyze raw DWI+b0/ADC (with optional 4D PWI) or a pre-registered MNI152 stroke lesion mask to produce masks, radiological report, QFV tables, TreeSHAP attributions and StrokeView cohort summary.

adc.description: Optional ADC map (native space with DWI, or MNI152 1 mm with an MNI lesion mask)

b0.description: Optional native-space b0 scan used to compute ADC when ADC is not supplied

bval.description: Optional FSL .bval sidecar specifying b-values for multi-volume 4D DWI

pwi.description: Optional 4D perfusion-weighted MRI series for TTP and hypoperfusion segmentation

pwi-json.description: Optional BIDS JSON sidecar with RepetitionTime and SliceTiming for 4D PWI

mask.description: Optional pre-registered MNI152 (182x218x182) stroke lesion mask for direct StrokeView reporting

brainmask.description: Optional MNI152 (182x218x182) brain mask paired with an MNI lesion mask and ADC

runSyn.description: Run nonlinear ANTs SyN warp after affine MNI152 registration

runShap.description: Compute exact TreeSHAP feature attributions for regional classifiers

threshold.description: Probability threshold applied to DAGMNet DWI stroke segmentation

pwiThreshold.description: Probability threshold applied to DAGMNet PWI hypoperfusion segmentation

cohortK.description: Number of nearest StrokeFAIR cohort neighbors summarized in StrokeView
